title: Hearty Savory Mediterranean Beef Kebabs
description: Savory and indulgent Mediterranean dish featuring lean minced beef and confit tomato, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the convenience of kebabs.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the minced beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Thread the beef mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the confit tomato with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked through.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional oregano and lemon wedges if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
